name: Windows - Security Analytics - Windows Updates
description: Dashboard providing security analytics on Windows Update events.
title: Windows - Security Analytics - Windows Updates

queries.queryString:
sumo.datasource=windows deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} host.group={{host.group}} host.name={{host.name}} "Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient" {{Computer}} {{EventID}} {{Task}}

| json "channel", "provider", "event_id", "computer","task" as Channel, Provider, EventID, Computer, Task nodrop
| json field=EventID "qualifiers","id" as  qualifiers, EventID
| json field=Provider "guid","event_source","name" as  Guid, EventSource,Provider
| where Channel = "System"
| where Provider = "Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient"
| where EventID matches "{{EventID}}"
| where Computer matches "{{Computer}}"
| where Task matches "{{Task}}"


| timeslice 1h
| count as Events _timeslice, EventID
| transpose row _timeslice column EventID
| order by _timeslice

sumo.datasource=windows deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} host.group={{host.group}} host.name={{host.name}} "Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient" {{Computer}} {{EventID}} {{Task}}

| json "channel", "provider", "event_id", "computer","task" as Channel, Provider, EventID, Computer, Task nodrop
| json field=EventID "qualifiers","id" as  qualifiers, EventID
| json field=Provider "guid","event_source","name" as  Guid, EventSource,Provider
| where Channel = "System"
| where Provider = "Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient"
| where EventID matches "{{EventID}}"
| where Computer matches "{{Computer}}"
| where Task matches "{{Task}}"

| count as Events Task

sumo.datasource=windows deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} host.group={{host.group}} host.name={{host.name}} "Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient" {{Computer}} {{EventID}} {{Task}}

| json "channel", "provider", "event_id", "computer","task" as Channel, Provider, EventID, Computer, Task nodrop
| json field=EventID "qualifiers","id" as  qualifiers, EventID
| json field=Provider "guid","event_source","name" as  Guid, EventSource,Provider
| where Channel = "System"
| where Provider = "Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient"
| where EventID matches "{{EventID}}"
| where Computer matches "{{Computer}}"
| where Task matches "{{Task}}"

| "** Unknown **" as Description

| if(EventID="16", "Unable to connect.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="17", "Installation Ready.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="18", "Installation Ready.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="19", "Installation Successful.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="20", "Installation Failure.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="21", "Restart Required.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="22", "Restart Required.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="27", "Automatic Updates is now paused.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="43", "Installation Started.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="44", "Windows Update started downloading an update.", Description) as Description

| formatDate(_messageTime, "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss") as date

| count as Events Date, Computer, EventID, Description, Task
| order by date

sumo.datasource=windows deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} host.group={{host.group}} host.name={{host.name}} "Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient" {{Computer}} {{EventID}} {{Task}}

| json "channel", "provider", "event_id", "computer","task" as Channel, Provider, EventID, Computer, Task nodrop

| json field=Provider "guid","event_source","name" as  Guid, EventSource,Provider
| where Channel = "System"

| where EventID matches "{{EventID}}"
| where Computer matches "{{Computer}}"
| where Task matches "{{Task}}"

| count as Events by EventID

| "** Unknown **" as Description

| if(EventID="16", "Unable to connect.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="17", "Installation Ready.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="18", "Installation Ready.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="19", "Installation Successful.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="20", "Installation Failure.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="21", "Restart Required.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="22", "Restart Required.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="27", "Automatic Updates is now paused.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="43", "Installation Started.", Description) as Description
| if(EventID="44", "Windows Update started downloading an update.", Description) as Description

| fields EventId, Description, Events
| order by EventId asc
